beats.text: They read every case study. [Then they went quiet.]
More proof won't fix it if they [doubt your motives].
Say what's out of scope and [what could change it].
Name the decision it supports and the [client time] it needs.
Buyers trust firms that show [the limits], not just the upside.

end.title: Show the [boundaries] too.
end.lede: B2B trust formation: the full guide.
